item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Amnesty International reported that enforced disappearances and extrajudicial executions persisted, describing a pattern involving the Rapid Action Battalion and noting that the government had previously supported recommendations to investigate and bring suspected perpetrators to justice; it called for investigations into disappearance allegations.","notes":["The excerpt does not establish that the government had not adequately investigated or brought suspected perpetrators to justice."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Amnesty International reported continued suppression of peaceful protests through tear gas, rubber bullets, batons, stun grenades, water cannon, and sometimes lethal force, and called for impartial investigations, discipline of responsible law-enforcement officials, and release of those arbitrarily arrested or detained.","notes":["The excerpt calls for release of all arbitrarily arrested and detained persons, not specifically protesters."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"RSF reported that Hasina’s cabinet approved a proposed Cyber Security Act on 7 August 2023 to replace the Digital Security Act; it described the bill as leaving broad room for arbitrary interpretation, being drafted without consulting media professionals, and advancing before the January 2024 election. The bill was still awaiting parliamentary approval; if passed, existing DSA cases would be judged under the new law.","notes":["The excerpt makes continuation of existing cases under the new law conditional on the bill being passed."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0014-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"RSF reported online threats and a death fatwa against journalist Asad Noor, investigation of journalist Adhora Yasmean under the Digital Security Act, arrest warrants against two journalists after reporting alleged drug-trafficking involvement, threats against families of exiled journalists, and physical attacks or expulsion of journalists while reporting in August 2023.","notes":["The excerpt does not specifically characterize the reported drug-trafficking allegation as official-linked wrongdoing."]}]}
